# telnyx_fqdn_connection_authentication (Resource)

The authentication settings of an FQDN connection. Destroy removes them from Terraform state only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Destroy removes the settings from Terraform state only.
resource "telnyx_fqdn_connection_authentication" "example" {
  fqdn_connection_id           = telnyx_fqdn_connection.example.id
  fqdn_outbound_authentication = "credential-authentication"
  user_name                    = "acme-pbx"
  password                     = var.pbx_password
}

variable "pbx_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fqdn_connection_id` (String) The fqdn connection id.

### Optional

- `failover_url` (String) The failover webhook URL.
- `fqdn_outbound_authentication` (String) The outbound authentication type. One of `credential-authentication`, `ip-authentication`.
- `ip_authentication_method` (String) The IP authentication method. One of `p-charge-info`, `token`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password for authentication. For primary accounts created on or after September 8, 2026, this password is returned as `********`. The password is returned in full on create, and on update only when that update changed the password. Accounts created before September 8, 2026 are unaffected.
- `txt_name` (String) The TXT record name for Microsoft Teams SBC DNS verification.
- `txt_ttl` (Number) The TTL for the TXT record.
- `txt_value` (String) The TXT record value for Microsoft Teams SBC DNS verification.
- `user_name` (String) The username for authentication.
- `webhook_url` (String) The webhook URL for authentication events.

### Read-Only

- `connection_id` (String) The ID of the FQDN connection this authentication strategy belongs to.
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `microsoft_teams_sbc` (Boolean) Whether the connection is a Microsoft Teams SBC.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_fqdn_connection_authentication.example <fqdn_connection_id>
```
